item.title: [−1] Sensex opens about 0.5% higher near 82,033 and Nifty near 25,240 as crude eases; rupee at 94.22
item.description:
Indices recovered Friday's losses in early Monday trade, though realty and metal indices fell about 1%. The rupee opened 3 paise firmer. Wholesale inflation data is due today. Reversing Friday's 0.61% Nifty fall.

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Rate-hike worry persists

Why it matters: Softer oil and continued foreign buying are offsetting rate-hike worries; weak metals reflect poor Chinese data, and the wholesale inflation print is the next test.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days
